rtr.text: The Rubblebelt is the wild edge of Ravnica, where Cecilee, feeling called to establish a settlement, ignores Ruzi's warnings and leads twenty followers to the wildest place any of them could imagine.
When Trostani senses a troubling situation, Mazena orders Ruzi to leave for the Rubblebelt, and he and Kuma reach its edge and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.

There Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos, and Nikya declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
In the Gruul's own tribes, the boy Domri is dressed in burial garb and buried in the ceremonial grave by the shaman Sabast, and he later returns from it, and Sabast refuses to banish him.

gtc.text: In the Rubblebelt, Kal is sent by Nikya of the Old Ways to watch the Izzet from an abandoned Orzhov spire and make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory.
When Durri tells him that a Selesnyan healer's camp was massacred, reportedly by the Rakdos, Kal secretly tracks the war party to protect her.

As the Zhur-Taa fight the Rakdos swarm and the tide turns against them, Kal channels what he learned from the Izzet into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates the flailer, the demons and the remaining Rakdos.
Domri also commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt, and Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.

rna.text: In the Rubblebelt, the tattooist Arrus makes ink for the Ghor Clan, but he can only pretend to feel the Rage that spreads through the crowd at the ruined battlefront, and the ink he made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, so Ruric and Thar cast him out.
Clanless, Arrus notices that the region's plants, animals and food are failing, and the shaman Baas Radley teaches him to face a charging battleboar herd.
He discovers that the trees on the Selesnyan border were planted as a fast-grown barrier that leeches magic from the Rubblebelt.

Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar and is beaten, but he finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and when he tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, they join him and declare war on Selesnya.
